subject.title: feat(dashboard): pinned MCP apps — board rendering, lease re-mint, durable tool grants

question: Should OpenClaw commit to `board.widget.appView` and revision-bound durable MCP App tool grants as a supported core gateway and dashboard contract?
rationale: This PR adds a new public gateway method, persistent grant state, and a lasting authorization model; code review cannot determine whether that core product/API commitment is intended.

options.title: Sponsor the core contract
options.body: Accept the dashboard feature and require runtime proof plus focused upgrade/restart coverage before merge.

options.title: Constrain the first release
options.body: Keep pinned MCP Apps read-only until a separately approved durable-grant contract is designed and documented.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Defer the PR until owners decide the permanent protocol, persistence, and authorization boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core contract
recommendation.body: Accept the dashboard feature and require runtime proof plus focused upgrade/restart coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete is assigned to and has authored the current end-to-end implementation, making them the best available routing point for the intended product contract.
